Threshold Report: Download with AP Allocation

# Threshold Report "Download Excel Report" with AP allocation. # If the company has an active AP allocation rule, compute the allocated # Change in A/P for the wizard period, store it as the manual amount of the # company's "Change in Accounts Payable" mapping row, then run the normal # report. Without a rule the report runs exactly as before. wizard = record if not wizard.company_id: raise UserError("Please select a company.") if wizard.duration == 'year' and not wizard.year: raise UserError("Please select a year.") if wizard.duration == 'quarter' and (not wizard.year or not wizard.quarter): raise UserError("Please select a year and quarter.") if wizard.duration == 'month' and (not wizard.year or not wizard.month): raise UserError("Please select a year and month.")
rule = env['x_threshold_ap_rule'].sudo().search([('x_company_id', '=', wizard.company_id.id)], limit=1) if rule: year = int(wizard.year or datetime.date.today().year) if wizard.duration == 'quarter': start_month = {'Q1': 1, 'Q2': 4, 'Q3': 7, 'Q4': 10}[wizard.quarter] date_from = datetime.date(year, start_month, 1) date_to = date_from + dateutil.relativedelta.relativedelta(months=3, days=-1) period = '%s %s' % (wizard.quarter, year) elif wizard.duration == 'month': date_from = datetime.date(year, int(wizard.month), 1) date_to = date_from + dateutil.relativedelta.relativedelta(months=1, days=-1) period = '%s-%02d' % (year, int(wizard.month)) else: date_from = datetime.date(year, 1, 1) date_to = datetime.date(year, 12, 31) period = str(year) preview = env['x_threshold_ap_preview'].sudo().create({ 'x_name': 'Threshold Report %s - %s' % (wizard.company_id.name, period), 'x_rule_id': rule.id, 'x_date_from': date_from, 'x_date_to': date_to, 'x_source': 'Threshold Report', }) env.ref('threshold_report_ap_import.action_ap_preview_compute').sudo().with_context( active_model='x_threshold_ap_preview', active_id=preview.id, active_ids=[preview.id]).run() # The base report adds this row to Change in A/R, so store -change for A/R - A/P. value = preview.x_change if rule.x_net_change_mode == 'ar_minus_ap': value = -value Mapping = env['threshold.report.account.mapping'].sudo() mapping = Mapping.search([('company_id', '=', wizard.company_id.id), ('row_key', '=', 'change_payables')], limit=1) if not mapping: mapping = Mapping.create({'company_id': wizard.company_id.id, 'row_key': 'change_payables'}) mapping.line_ids.unlink() mapping.write({'amount': value}) action = wizard.action_download_excel()
